checked_claims.note: R1: relative duality supplies gamma^*E -> omega_{C/P^1}; for finite flat Gorenstein covers the relative dualizing sheaf is invertible and the CE relative-canonical map is the associated quotient, so O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C = omega_{C/P^1} = omega_C tensor gamma^*O(2). Packet/SRC-0004 degree 2g+6 forces any residual P^1-twist to be trivial. Algebra then gives W_5 = omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D), L = omega_C(-D) deg 6, M = O_C(D) deg 4, matching deg W_5 = 4g+12-4*5 = 16. Closes GAP-Z-W5D under the packet convention with gamma^*O(-5).

R2: RR chi(L)=1 and Serre duality h^1(L)=h^0(O_C(D)) give h^0(L)=1+h^0(D). Projection formula h^0(gamma^*O(1))=h^0(O(1) tensor gamma_*O_C)=2+#{a_i=1}. Under E^vee=O(-3)^{oplus 3} one gets h^0(D)=2, h^0(L)=3, h^1(L)=2 constantly on the stated locus. Uses E-balancedness; F-balancedness is not required for this count.

R3 bpf: 0->E->E'=gamma_*O_C(p)->k(y)->0, h^0(E')=1 forces exactly one b_i=0 and others <=-1. Image of E'(-1)->E' lands in E. Any b_j=-1 yields O(-1)oplus O(-2) inside E'(-1) whose composite into O(-3)^{oplus 3} vanishes by Hom vanishing, impossible rank-2-into-rank-1. Thus b_j<=-2, h^0(O_C(D+p))=2, and RR gives h^0(L-p)=2<h^0(L). Argument is sharp against competing types such as O oplus O(-1) oplus O(-3) oplus O(-4).

R3 nonemptiness: char-0 Bertini for a base-point-free complete g^2_6 on a smooth curve yields a general reduced 6-point member; reduced-support locus is a nonempty open in P^2 and not closed. With Z_ev the Conf_6 pullback of that open (R5/(T5)), Z_ev is nonempty on every fully balanced geometric fibre. Avoids the chi(L)=1 dead route (FND-0083).

R4: h^0(W_5)=11 (deg 16>10 => h^1=0); (T1)(T3) give Fit_0(coker phi)=I_12(phi)=Fit_0(coker phi_5)=I_6(phi_5). On Z_ev, N trivial => coker fibre = H^1(omega_C)=k, so rank phi_5=5 and rank phi=11 identically and D_4(phi_5)=D_10(phi)=empty. Expected codimensions (11-5)(6-5)=6 and (26-11)(12-11)=15 are the standard degeneracy counts.

R5 identification/dimension: scheme-theoretic AJ fibre over [L] is P(H^0(L)) (Div^6 / FND-0107); (T5) identifies Z_ev with N-relatively-trivial locus, hence Z_ev = Conf_6 x_{Sym^6} P(H^0(L)). Conf_6 -> red-support open of Sym^6 is finite etale S_6-torsor (FND-0064), so Z_ev is reduced smooth pure dim 2, degree 720 over the red-support open of |L|~P^2, codim 4 in U=Conf_6, excess 2 over expected determinantal codim 6. Dimension comes from the fibre product, not a parameter count.

R5 local structure: closed immersion of smooth k-schemes is regular, so I/I^2 is locally free of rank 4 (lci of actual codim 4). (T4) supplies 6 local generators of Fit_0 as pullbacks of parameters of e in Pic^0; grade/height 4 forbids a regular sequence of length 6. Connecting map of 0->O->O(Gamma)->O_Gamma(Gamma)->0 has rank da_N = 6-(h^0(L)-1)=6-h^0(D)=4 along Z_ev, corank 2 matching excess. Respects FND-0068 (excess alone does not force non-lci).

R6: on reduced B with all geometric fibres fully balanced, h^0(L_b)=3 and h^1(L_b)=2 constant => Grauert gives pi_*L locally free rank 3 with base change. P(pi_*L) independent of Pic(B) twists of L. Relative AJ/Div description plus (T5) and FND-0064 yield Z_ev = Conf_6(C/B) x_{Sym^6} P(pi_*L) smooth surjective of pure relative dim 2 and relative codim 4 in Conf_6(C/B). No M_{6,6} image, purity, stabilizer, Gysin, or Tate claim is asserted.

Theorem and Step 7 correctly exclude: equivalence of E- vs F-balancedness; dim of balanced Hurwitz base; any map/codim/component/stabilizer/closure/Gysin statement in M_{6,6}; irreducibility of Z_ev; unbalanced/h^0-jumping strata; Hodge/Tate conclusions on W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}. strongest_attack: Strongest pressure: reducedness of the Fitting scheme Z_ev = V(Fit_0) cannot be read from the differential da_N alone, because rank(da_N) jumps (4 along Z_ev, 6 on a dense open), so the constant-rank normal form does not apply and a non-submersive Abel-Jacobi map could a priori cut a non-reduced scheme fibre. Outcome: attack fails for the stated theorem. ATT-0048 (T4) identifies Fit_0 with a_N^{-1}(I_e) as ideals; the classical scheme-theoretic Abel-Jacobi fibre over [L] is the reduced complete linear system P(H^0(L)); pullback along the etale S_6-torsor Conf_6 -> red-support open of Sym^6 preserves reducedness and smoothness. Thus Fitting structure equals the reduced smooth pure-dimension-2 structure, codim 4, lci, excess 2 = corank(da_N). Secondary pressure on R1 (surjectivity of gamma^*E ->> omega_{C/P^1}) is standard CE relative-canonical content and is pinned by SRC-0004/FND-0105 degree forcing; not fatal. No stack/coarse, integral-coefficient, BM/cohomology degree, Poincare/Tate-twist, Gysin/Kunneth, spectral-sequence, invariants/coinvariants, semisimplification, predicted-motive, or pure-Tate-upgrade error is load-bearing in this scoped lemma.
theorem_statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0 and let C be a smooth projective connected curve of genus 6 over k equipped with a finite flat morphism gamma : C -> P^1 of degree 4 whose Casnati-Ekedahl data are fully balanced, meaning gamma_*O_C = O_{P^1} direct-sum E^vee with E^vee isomorphic to O_{P^1}(-3)^{oplus 3} AND the CE relations bundle F isomorphic to O_{P^1}(4) direct-sum O_{P^1}(5). Put D := gamma^*(pt) (degree 4), W := (O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*F^vee)|_C with its canonical CE filtration 0 -> W_4 -> W -> W_5 -> 0 of fibrewise degrees d_4 = 20, d_5 = 16 (ATT-0048 CLM-0048-6, confirmed by REV-0091/REV-0092), L := W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}, U := Conf_6(C) the 6-dimensional space of ordered pairwise-distinct 6-tuples, Gamma the universal degree-6 divisor on C x U, phi : H^0(C,W) tensor O_U -> pi_*(W|_Gamma) and phi_5 : H^0(C,W_5) tensor O_U -> pi_*(W_5|_Gamma) the CE evaluations, and Z_ev := V(Fit_0(coker phi)) subset U the CE evaluation-failure locus with its determinantal/Fitting scheme structure (ATT-0048 (T1),(T3),(T4),(T6)). Then: (R1) O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C = omega_{C/P^1} = omega_C tensor gamma^*O_{P^1}(2), hence W_5 = omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D), L = omega_C(-D) of degree 6, and M := omega_C^{tensor 2} tensor W_5^vee = O_C(D) of degree 4. (R2) h^0(C,L) = 1 + h^0(C,O_C(D)); writing E^vee = direct-sum_{i=1}^3 O(-a_i) with a_i >= 1 and sum a_i = 9 one has h^0(C,O_C(D)) = 2 + #{i : a_i = 1}; under E^vee = O(-3)^{oplus 3} this gives h^0(O_C(D)) = 2, h^0(L) = 3 and h^1(L) = 2 exactly. (R3) L is base-point-free: for every p in C the sheaf gamma_*O_C(p) is isomorphic to O direct-sum O(b_2) direct-sum O(b_3) direct-sum O(b_4) with all b_j <= -2, whence h^0(O_C(D+p)) = 2 and no p is a base point of |L|; consequently in characteristic 0 the general member of |L| = P(H^0(L)) = P^2 consists of 6 pairwise-distinct points, the reduced-support locus is a nonempty open (and not closed) subset of that P^2, and Z_ev is nonempty. (R4) Rank-drop ideal: Fit_0(coker phi) = Fit_0(coker phi_5) = I_6(phi_5) = I_12(phi), where phi_5 is an 11-by-6 and phi a 26-by-12 evaluation matrix; at every point of Z_ev the cokernel is H^1(C, omega_C tensor N^{-1}) with N := O_C(Gamma) tensor L^{-1} trivial, hence has length exactly 1, so rank phi_5 = 5 and rank phi = 11 identically on Z_ev and the deeper degeneracy loci D_4(phi_5) = D_10(phi) are empty; the expected determinantal codimensions are (11-5)(6-5) = 6 in the reduced presentation and (26-11)(12-11) = 15 in the unreduced presentation. (R5) Fibre dimension and local structure: Z_ev is canonically the pullback of the reduced-support open of |L| = P^2 along the finite etale S_6-torsor Conf_6(C) -> (reduced-support open of Sym^6 C); it is therefore reduced and smooth of pure dimension exactly 2, finite etale of degree 720 onto that open, so codim(Z_ev, U) = 6 - 2 = 4 exactly and the excess over the expected determinantal codimension 6 is exactly 2; the conormal module I_{Z_ev}/I_{Z_ev}^2 is locally free of rank 4 although Fit_0(coker phi) is locally generated by the 6 pullbacks of local generators of I_e, and this excess 2 equals the corank of the Abel-Jacobi differential da_N : T_Gamma Conf_6(C) -> T_e Pic^0(C), whose rank is identically 6 - h^0(O_C(D)) = 4 along Z_ev; in particular Z_ev is everywhere a local complete intersection of codimension 4 in the smooth 6-fold U and is nowhere cut out by a regular sequence of length 6. (R6) Relative form: if B is a reduced locally Noetherian k-scheme and (C -> B, gamma) a family all of whose geometric fibres satisfy the above hypotheses, then pi_*L is locally free of rank 3 with formation commuting with arbitrary base change, P(pi_*L) subset Sym^6_{C/B} is a P^2-bundle canonically independent of the Pic(B)-twist ambiguity in L, and Z_ev subset Conf_6(C/B) is the pullback of the reduced-support open of P(pi_*L) along the finite etale S_6-torsor; hence Z_ev -> B is smooth and surjective of pure relative dimension exactly 2 and Z_ev has relative codimension exactly 4 in Conf_6(C/B). No dimension, codimension, component, purity, stabilizer, closure or Gysin statement about any image in M_{6,6} is asserted, and no Hodge-theoretic or Tate-type conclusion about W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) is asserted.
